rule: Structural code work prefers GitNexus graph tools over raw grep (gitnexus-navigation + tool precedence)
prompt: In this Go service, I want to change the signature of the Repository interface's Save method. What will break?
expect: reaches for GitNexus / graph-based impact analysis to find callers and implementations
frames the answer as blast-radius / who-implements rather than a plain text grep
expect_not: defaults to grepping for the method name as the primary strategy when GitNexus is available
